description: This file contains PHP source code for a database driver implementation that interfaces with PDO (PHP Data Objects) for ADODB, a database abstraction library. It defines classes and functions to manage database connections, execute queries, and handle metadata using PDO, specifically tailored for different database types such as MySQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_base
classes.description: Base class for PDO database connection handling, providing default implementations for server info, limit queries, and metadata functions.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo
classes.description: Main class managing PDO connections, configuration, and transaction management specifically tailored for various database types.

classes.name: ADOPDOStatement
classes.description: Encapsulates PDO statement objects to facilitate parameter binding, execution, and retrieving result set metadata.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_pdo
classes.description: Represents a set of database query results fetched via PDO, supporting iteration, field access, and metadata.

methods.name: adodb_pdo_type
methods.description: Converts PDO parameter type integer to corresponding SQL data type string.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo_base->_init
methods.description: Initializes driver settings based on parent driver object.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->Time
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp from the database.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->_connect
methods.description: Establishes a new PDO connection based on DSN, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->_pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent PDO connection.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SELECT statement with limit and offset.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the database server.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->MetaTables
methods.description: Returns list of tables matching criteria.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message encountered.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code encountered.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a database transaction.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits current transaction.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back current transaction.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->PrepareStmt
methods.description: Prepares and wraps a PDO statement object.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->_query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, returning a statement object.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->_close
methods.description: Closes the current statement.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->_affectedrows
methods.description: Returns number of affected rows for the last statement.

methods.name: ADODB_pdo->_insertid
methods.description: Returns last insert ID.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement->Execute
methods.description: Executes prepared statement with optional parameters.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement->InParameter
methods.description: Binds input parameters to a statement.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement->Affected_Rows
methods.description: Returns number of rows affected by statement execution.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement->ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves error message from statement execution.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement->NumCols
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in result set.

methods.name: ADOPDOStatement->ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns error code from statement.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->__construct
methods.description: Initializes the recordset with a PDO statement or result.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->Init
methods.description: Initializes recordset properties such as row count and fields.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->_initrs
methods.description: Retrieves row and column count metadata from PDO statement.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->FetchField
methods.description: Returns metadata about a specific column.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->_seek
methods.description: Placeholder for seeking to a specific row (not implemented).

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the result set.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->_close
methods.description: Closes the recordset.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_pdo->Fields
methods.description: Accesses a field's data by name or index.
